+--------+            +-----------+     +--------------+     +---------------+     +-------------+     +----------------+     +----------+
| Client |            | MobileApp |     | CloudService |     | DataProcessor |     | Transaction |     | TransactionsDB |     | EventBus |
+----+---+            +-----+-----+     +-------+------+     +-------+-------+     +------+------+     +--------+-------+     +-----+----+
     |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   |
     | Initiate transaction |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   |
     +--------------------->|                   |                    |                    |                     |                   |
     |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   |
     |                      | Authenticate      |                    |                    |                     |                   |
     |                      +------------------>|                    |                    |                     |                   |
   + alt Authentication successful ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      | Auth token        |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |<..................+                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      | Process data      |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      +--------------------------------------->|                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    | Create transaction |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    +------------------->|                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    | Save record         |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    +-------------------->|                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    | Confirmation        |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |<....................+                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    | Publish event       |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    +---------------------------------------->| |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | | Notification         |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |<.............................................................................................................................+ |   
   + else Authentication failed ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      | Error             |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |<..................+                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |                      |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | | Show error           |                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   | |<.....................+                   |                    |                    |                     |                   | |   
   +----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
